members.short_reason: [llm] cluster primary: Both rewrite the trailing-slash-stripping logic inside buildWellKnownPath (and, for #2214, the duplicate inline logic in buildDiscoveryUrls), replacing the single `endsWith('/') + slice(0,-1)` strip with a `/\/+$/` regex so paths with multiple trailing slashes normalize correctly. They edit the identical lines of buildWellKnownPath, so merging both as-is would conflict. (2 PRs)
members.cluster_pick_reason: #2215 fixes an actual behavioral bug, not just cosmetics: shouldAttemptFallback compared pathname === '/' to detect 'already at root', but by the time pathname reaches that check it has already been stripped to '' by the caller's slash-stripping, so the early return never fired and redundant fallback requests were always attempted for root-like discovery URLs. #2215's normalizeDiscoveryPath() helper both regex-strips trailing slashes (same fix #2214 makes) and maps root to '' consistently, then updates the comparison to match ('' instead of '/'), closing the dead-code path. #2214 is changeset-less and labeled 'chore' - it only swaps the strip method for the multi-slash edge case in two call sites and never touches the broken '/' comparison in shouldAttemptFallback, so the redundant-fallback bug survives even after #2214 merges.

clusters.pick_reason: #1996 adds a dedicated acceptsMediaType() helper implementing proper Accept-header parsing: splits multiple media ranges, parses q= parameters and excludes entries with q=0, and matches type/subtype including wildcard forms (*/*, type/*). #2046 fixes the same reported behavior with a plain acceptHeader?.includes('application/json') substring check, which doesn't exclude an explicit q=0 decline and doesn't handle wildcard media ranges or parameterized values - a narrower patch to the same underlying validation bug.

clusters.pick_reason: #2215 fixes an actual behavioral bug, not just cosmetics: shouldAttemptFallback compared pathname === '/' to detect 'already at root', but by the time pathname reaches that check it has already been stripped to '' by the caller's slash-stripping, so the early return never fired and redundant fallback requests were always attempted for root-like discovery URLs. #2215's normalizeDiscoveryPath() helper both regex-strips trailing slashes (same fix #2214 makes) and maps root to '' consistently, then updates the comparison to match ('' instead of '/'), closing the dead-code path. #2214 is changeset-less and labeled 'chore' - it only swaps the strip method for the multi-slash edge case in two call sites and never touches the broken '/' comparison in shouldAttemptFallback, so the redundant-fallback bug survives even after #2214 merges.

members.author: raashish1601
